name: image-generation
description: Image generation skills for original editorial illustrations, mascot-led visual metaphors, article art, diagrams, mini-comics, and print-style visual systems.

interface.shortDescription: 生成原创编辑插画、角色化视觉隐喻、文章配图和手绘解释图。
interface.longDescription: Image Generation packages tmchow/illo-skill as a Codex skill for original editorial illustrations where a recurring mascot performs the idea. It supports article art, single-concept visuals, mini-comics, hand-built explainer diagrams, custom characters, ten bundled print looks, palette derivation, Codex CLI image generation, and OpenRouter fallback.
defaultPrompt: Use illo to illustrate this article with one editorial image.
Use illo to create a mascot-led visual metaphor for this idea.
Use illo to make a mini-comic explaining this before-and-after.
